atoms.b: The ancient Egyptians believed that the pharaohs were gods in ((++human liquid)) form and that the world would fall apart without them.
All were said to be descended from Ra, the ((++god goat)) of the Sun.
Only pharaohs and priests were allowed to enter the ((++temples markets)).

instruction.text: As pharaohs were seen as gods, they needed burial places to match their status. Build the pyramid by dragging the blocks to the correct places.
Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: The pyramids were built to honour the pharaohs after they died. They stored their mummified bodies and all the items they would need on their journey to the afterlife.
The ancient Egyptians built pyramids during the Old and Middle Kingdoms. In total, over 100 pyramids have been discovered!
The first pyramid was made for Pharaoh Djoser, but the most famous was built for Pharaoh Khufu — you might know it better as the Great Pyramid of Giza.

hint.text: By the time Cleopatra was Pharaoh during the New Kingdom, these pyramids were already about 2,000 years old!
hint.label: Did you know?

atoms.a: How many pyramids have been discovered?
What were some of the uses for a pyramid?
Which two of these pharaohs were buried in pyramids?

feedback.end: Pharaohs in the New Kingdom, such as Tutankhamun, were typically buried in tombs instead of pyramids.
